WITH player_counts AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as award_count
  FROM manager_award
  GROUP BY player_id
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total
  FROM manager_award
)
SELECT 
  pc.player_id,
  pc.award_count,
  CAST(pc.award_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as fraction
FROM player_counts pc, total_count tc
WHERE tc.total > 0
ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: If the manager_award table is empty (total count = 0), return empty result set per 'return nothing if that total is missing'
